programme.title: Henry Danger S3 Ep.316: Swellview’s Got Talent
programme.desc: After discovering contestants on Swellview's Got Talent are losing consciousness, Captain Man and Kid Danger enlist the help of Charlotte and Schwoz in order to find out what is causing the mischief.

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay S1 Ep.111: Ha-Lay Lay-Lujah!
programme.desc: Sadie, Lay Lay, and the Alexander family go to church for their monthly visit. Sadie tries to show everyone she is ready to become a junior deacon. Lay Lay struggles with the guilt of eating Bryce's special ice cream and experiences strange glitches.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.104: Houbi Houba Heist / Twister's Treehouse
programme.desc: Mica's Marsup journal ends up in Acu's bag so he has to get it back before his friend finds it. // Twister, is fed up of Hope and Punch's pranks, so he builds his own cardboard house which Stan finds.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.105: Mar-Snoop / Canteen Carnage
programme.desc: On her quest to get her own Marsupilami, Bibi encounters a Jaguar which scares her enough to give up the hunt. // Marcel gets a job as the school chef after Jade causes the usual one to quit.

programme.title: The Loud House S7 Ep.707: Road Trip: From Brad to Worse / Road Trip: Doll Day Afternoon
programme.desc: When the Louds run into Mom's old camp crush turned celebrity at a State Fair, Dad tries to one-up him to impress Rita. // Realizing Mr. Coconuts is missing, Luan rallies the Louds to track him down along Route 66.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 Ep.125: The Price of Admission / One Flu Over the Loud House
programme.desc: After seeing a scary movie (that his parents told him not to), Lincoln can’t go to sleep and pulls an all-nighter. // When a common cold ravages through the loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into Zombies!

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.304: Selfie Improvement
programme.desc: When Carol Pingrey's photo gets more likes on social media than Lori's she tries to one-up her.

programme.title: Sonic Prime S1 Ep.105: Barking Up the Wrong Tree
programme.desc: Sonic is shocked that the Boscage Maze "Monster" is Amy AKA Thorn Rose. Wielding a Paradox Prism shard, Thorn wages war on the tree-dwelling Scavengers. Sonic must save these savage Shatter-Friends from each other to find a way home.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.413: Terror on Tape
programme.desc: The Stars watch a series of haunted video tapes.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S17 Ep.333: The Nerds / The SquarePants Method
programme.desc: When Squidward sets out to prove that anyone can write a comic book, his work garners an obsessed fan base. // An actor shadows SpongeBob in preparation for his next big movie role.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.103: Dance Off / The show must go on
programme.desc: Jade's a great dancer which results in her facing Mr Best for dance off in person. // Mica and Jade put on a play to win their school a prize, but forget a key prop so the Marsups step in to help.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.116: Flower Power
programme.desc: Stan lures the Marsupilamis with the scent from his 100 year orchid, and manages to catch all three.

programme.title: The Loud House S9 Ep.906: Rough Patch
programme.desc: To earn her next patch and become a golden Snickerdoodle, Lola must spend quality time with Sunset Canyon senior, Bernie.

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.320: Jeers for Fears / Tea Tale Heart
programme.desc: After agreeing to go to The Royal Woods House of Terror, Linc and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears. // Lola discovers Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it - no matter what Lucy says.

programme.title: The Loud House S10 Ep.1003: Spy Dames / Cupid's Harrow
programme.desc: During Grandparent's Day at Lincoln's school, he and Myrtle face off with a spy nemesis from Myrtle's past. // Leni accidentally causes trouble for Lori and Bobby while taking calls on her and Miguel's dating podcast.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.103: The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs / The Missing Mole Rat Princess
programme.desc: Sam and Kit look for a mysterious bird who's messing with everyone's nests. // The duo tracks down a royal mole rat who left her underground palace.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S5 Ep.521: The Pet Competition
programme.desc: Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet...

programme.title: Peppa Pig S5 Ep.522: Spider's Web
programme.desc: Ew! There's a spider in the house! Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S5 Ep.523: The Noisy Night
programme.desc: Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is sleepy. But baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S5 Ep.524: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and the wishing well she's got for the garden, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S5 Ep.526: Madame Gazelle's Leaving Party
programme.desc: The children are sad because their favorite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving daycare. But a leaving party will give her a good send-off.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.601: The Queen
programme.desc: Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry, and Peppa and her friends are to accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.602: Desert Island
programme.desc: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig, Granddad Dog, and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.603: Perfume
programme.desc: After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.604: The Children's Fete
programme.desc: The school roof is leaky again, so the children organize a fair to raise money for a new roof.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.605: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.606: George's Racing Car
programme.desc: It's a beautiful day, but Peppa, George, Daddy Pig, and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching racecar driving on television!

programme.title: DORA S2 Ep.203: Isa's Royal Garden Party / Sammy's Surprise
programme.desc: The Queen of Reptiles is visiting Isa, but the garden's a mess! Dora helps her get everything ready in time for La Reina's visit. / Dora meets Sammy the Sloth, who needs to get to Day Camp on time so he can show everyone a special surprise.

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.413: Quest for the Blue Bananas
programme.desc: Dora meets Boots' cousin, Sombrera, and they journey across the rainforest to find the special blue bananas!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.103: Buzzy Croc / Dream House
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile worries he'll be caught between his old best friend Buzzy and his new best friend Daisy. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile's simple treehouse gets complicated when they try to add space for all their friends.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.109: Let Justice Be done / The Great Spring Clean
programme.desc: Barbabeau forgot to return his book to the library. As Mr Strict the librarian is visiting Barbapapa today, Barbabeau decides to run away. // Barbamama wants the barbababies to tidy their bedrooms. They're hiding to escape the drudgery.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.204: Dreaming Apprentices
programme.desc: To dream makes you grow... But what can Barbidur, Barbalala, Barbotine and Barbidou possibly dream of?

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.106: The Crew Builds A Skate Park / The Crew Builds A Tunnel
programme.desc: The Crew has a mishap while building a skatepark. // The Crew helps a pop star get her tour bus to town.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.207: The Crew Builds A Super Squirrely Whirly Playground
programme.desc: Rubble and the pups build Mix, Motor, Lucas, and Lily the coolest Super Squirrely Whirly playdate ever!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 Ep.1104: Pups Save Helga and the Humsquatch / Pups Save the Missing Bone-Stone
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger is getting dressed for a special day with his Hummy Mummy. // The Museum has a brand-new exhibit: the Emerald Bone-Stone! But when the precious bone goes missing.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S12 Ep.1203: Pups Stop a Coconut Catapult
programme.desc: The pups leap into action when Digi and Tal's coconut catapult goes out-of-control and rockets off through the jungle targeting birds and monkeys.

programme.title: Inheritors
programme.desc: Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on China’s rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country’s culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
